PDQ 81440, Power Supply Box

Low voltage power supply, UL Listed and tested to 294 Standard for Access Control System Units. Can be used with up to Two PDQ 6200RF630MLR Motorized Electric Latch Rim Exit Devices.

This power supply converts 120 Volt AC (120VAC) or 240 Volt AC (240VAC) to Regulated 24 Volts DC (24VDC). Automatically accepts 120VAC or 240VAC input without requiring to move jumpers or set Dip Switches. Auxiliary 24VDC constant voltage output for powering stand alone devices (Keypads, Motion Detectors, Status Indicators...).

Features for PDQ 81440 Power Supply

  • Up to Full 2 Amps Load Capacity
  • Class 2 Rated Outputs
  • Filtered/Regulated 24VDC
  • Overload, Over Voltage and Short Circuit Protection
  • Control Fail Safe or Fail Secure Locking Devices
  • Interface Relay Isolates Locking Device Current from Control Switch
  • Surge Suppression on Fail Safe and Fail Secure Outputs
  • UL Listed and Tested
